summary: A 37-year-old took a 30-foot fall while on rope on a mixed route on Taylor Peak. Northern Colorado Med Evac helped pinpoint the climber's location; a Colorado National Guard helicopter from Buckley Air Force Base hoisted the patient to Upper Beaver Meadows, with ground-ambulance transfer to Estes Park Health.
responding_agency: RMNP SAR; Colorado National Guard; Northern Colorado Med Evac
